crossRefs.note: Yahweh, how my adversaries have increased! Many are those who rise up against me.
All the nations surrounded me, but in Yahweh’s name, I cut them off.
Make an uproar, you peoples, and be broken in pieces! Listen, all you from far countries: dress for battle, and be…
for they are spirits of demons, performing signs; which go out to the kings of the whole inhabited earth, to gather…

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Merom
people.line: A place where Joshua defeated Jabin's coalition

translations.web: All these kings met together; and they came and encamped together at the waters of Merom, to fight with Israel.
translations.bsb: All these kings joined forces and encamped at the waters of Merom to fight against Israel.
translations.kjv: And when all these kings were met together, they came and pitched together at the waters of Merom, to fight against Israel.
translations.asv: And all these kings met together; and they came and encamped together at the waters of Merom, to fight with Israel.
